sql:
SELECT p.BrandName AS BrandName, sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS Profit
FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = toYear(subtractQuarters(toDate('2026-04-23'), 1))
  AND toQuarter(f.DateKey) = toQuarter(subtractQuarters(toDate('2026-04-23'), 1))
GROUP BY p.BrandName
ORDER BY Profit DESC
